ratings_why.fun: Placing Layers by what sits across, leaving nest-box gaps and watching Chicks shove their hosts is a game I'd happily draft, though the rules load costs it a point.
ratings_why.distinct: Over a 7: it is the only tribe that plays on the enemy's board, its Chicks grow from the opponent's size, and the fight clock adds a mid-fight beat no tribe has.

verdict_why: One wording fix on Ottilie remains; the rest of the cards read cleanly and the fantasy lands.

points.text: Grand Horologe Ottilie Gugger's "a unit hides only once" is cryptic: only Little Gernegroß hides. Say "Little Gernegroß hides only once".
Curfew Warden can pick Old Unruh as the biggest unit beside it, wasting its sleep. "The biggest awake unit next to this" would read and play better.
Little Gernegroß is four sentences. Moving the hide-and-return rule into a short keyword would let the card read at a glance.
Glirarium Keeper works only because On the Hour comes before waking. "before they wake" on the card would save players learning the order.
The fantasy lands in the actions: eggs in other nests, chicks heaving the host, dormice eating chicks, sleepers in jars. Keep the clock face and Egg markers central on screen.

standouts.why: Little Gernegroß literally becomes an egg on the biggest enemy and comes back huge: the seed's joke as a play.
Nest-Box Dormouse eating your own Chick is funny, true to the animal, and turns a fight token into permanent stats.
Old Unruh asleep all fight, marked present, waking only when the alarm rings, reads instantly and feels like the character.

weakest.why: Key-Turner is plain Wind 2: clear, but no woodland in what it does.
First-Call Herald is a gold card that only nods to the Hour; little cuckoo or clock flavour in the play.
Ottilie's delay-and-double is the hardest card to read in the tribe.

flags.note: "A unit hides only once" doesn't say which unit or why.
Golden Hour-Keeper striking every attack with Door Cuckoo and Kasimir makes many Eggs a fight.
With Old Unruh beside it, Curfew Warden's sleep and +3/+3 wait for the alarm; players may not expect that.
